value.message:
The "session user" and "session roles" shown here represent the effective user and roles consumed at the moment of this particular ACL (Access Control List) evaluation—these may differ from the physical user or agent initiator, depending on agent configuration. 

Session user: This is the user identity actually evaluated during the access check, and it may be the original invoking user or an agent identity based on agent configuration. 

Session roles: These are the roles currently active for the session. Roles may be assigned based on agent configuration, or may reflect a reduced set due to role masking, which determines the access checks that are performed. 

Learn more about agent configuration

• Passed: ACL requirements were met and access was granted
  • Blocked: ACL requirements were not met and access was not granted
  • Skipped: ACL requirements were not checked because they were not required
  • Undefined: No ACL requirements were set
